review_type: independent local duplicate-pool hotfix, prelaunch-only installer and public-package review

combined_validation_observed.scope: Parent-run combined regression result read from the hash-bound validation manifest; independently executed hotfix cases are listed separately

independent_regressions.execution_scope: Local root-owned temporary fixtures; actual job launch and exec mocked
checks: Repeated scalar assignments select the last value; array declaration history remains complete and ordered
Early and migration parsers agree; unsafe earlier array values cannot be hidden by later safe declarations
Migration preserves duplicate pool bytes except the reviewed socket branch substitution, including uppercase LISTEN
Fresh installation and repeated same-payload installation preserve job absence
Recognized prior source and diagnostic bytecode are archived intact without copying old bytecode into the new payload
State, worker markers, unit files, dangling links and loaded/active/PID-bearing systemd states refuse refresh
Unknown or modified code, extra files, symlinks, hardlinks and unrecognized bytecode refuse refresh
Existing wrapper requires exact recognized bytes and mode700; wrapper parent symlinks refuse before writes
Competing installer flock and state appearing during staging stop before prior payload archival
Relative-path old preflight processes are detected using process working directories
Admission lock remains inheritable and held through mocked foreground launch
Core launch refuses competing or wrong-inode descriptors, accepts a verified inherited descriptor and protects standard input
Exactly thirteen embedded runtime modules and the inline helper equal the delivered and reviewed sources; known prior payload hashes match immutable prior release manifests

actual_Python36_evidence.interpreter: Canonical-authenticated CPython3.6.9 privately extracted without package installation
passed: Nine early/helper modules compile; bootstrap and shared duplicate parser import
Mocked Bionic plan, pre-Noble PHP rejection and package logging remain compatible
Prelaunch helper performs fresh and idempotent start=False installation into private temporary fixtures
Delivered offline release verifier passes without executing the installer

findings_resolved: Case-folded LISTEN metadata was not reflected by the original case-sensitive socket rewrite
Nonprivate or nonexecutable existing wrapper modes were accepted
A symlinked wrapper parent could receive a write before validation failed
Relative-path old preflight invocations were missed by absolute-only process matching
limits: The refresh permission covers code-only recognized prelaunch failures, never existing queued, running or failed jobs
Array mapping entries are inventory conveniences, not a claim that all array directives use scalar last-assignment semantics
Native PHP-FPM configuration validation and runtime/application acceptance remain required
Local fixtures and extracted old Python do not reproduce a complete production OS, native APT transaction or application environment
No live release upgrade, live application migration or tested recovery claim is made
Existing database-major, mixed-runtime, custom-layout and failed-checkpoint holds remain in force
Static privacy checks cannot prove absence of every possible secret; runtime evidence and backups remain private
